brief: For Ukraine, the global vendor-reference channel is unusually thin: neither the ATM OEMs (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Hyosung, GRG) nor the international core-banking vendors (Temenos, Finastra, Tietoevry) surface a Ukrainian named-customer case study, and Diebold Nixdorf's divestment of its Russia/Ukraine assets makes withdrawn references a live hypothesis best tested through the Wayback Machine. The disclosure that does exist comes from three other places: payments-platform vendors with genuine UA history (OpenWay/WAY4 with Oschadbank, BPC/SmartVista's Ukrainian office), channel partners whose stated territory includes Ukraine (Transaction Systems reselling Auriga WWS), and non-obvious suppliers such as AWS, which published a detailed PrivatBank case study. The Ukrainian-language layer is dominated by the domestic core-banking vendor CS Ltd, whose /cases and press-centre pages name client banks (Bank Lviv, Pivdennyi, BIS Bank) and are the richest single local-language source in this cell, complemented by banker.ua and ain.ua as press-release mirrors. Because the buyer/supplier gap stays open on hardware, Prozorro procurement data and vendor partner-locator snowballing should be treated as first-class substitutes for missing vendor case studies.
